color-brand-moss.$description: Logo ink on light grounds. Fixed in both Themes; for the Logo, imagery and print, never an interface role.

color-brand-lichen.$description: Logo ink on dark grounds. Fixed in both Themes; for the Logo, imagery and print, never an interface role.

color-brand-sage.$description: Identity hue for imagery and print. Fixed in both Themes; never an interface role.

color-brand-peach.$description: Identity hue for imagery and print. Fixed in both Themes; never an interface role.

color-brand-ember.$description: Identity hue for imagery and print. Fixed in both Themes; never an interface role.

color-surface-raised.$description: A panel one step up from the page, such as a sidebar or a card.

color-surface-nested.$description: A panel inside a raised panel.

color-background-neutral-subtle.$description: Rest fill of quiet controls, rows and menu items (transparent).

color-background-neutral-subtle-hovered.$description: Hover fill of quiet controls, rows and menu items.

color-background-neutral-subtle-pressed.$description: Pressed fill of quiet controls, rows and menu items.

color-background-selected.$description: The current item in a set.

color-background-accent-bold.$description: The primary action and checked controls. Put text-on-accent on it.

color-background-accent-subtle.$description: A quiet accent fill that every text role reads on.

color-background-success-bold.$description: A filled success state. Put text-on-success on it.

color-background-success-subtle.$description: A tinted success fill, as in tags and toasts. Put text-success on it.

color-background-warning-bold.$description: A filled warning state. Put text-on-warning on it.

color-background-warning-subtle.$description: A tinted warning fill, as in tags and toasts. Put text-warning on it.

color-background-danger-bold.$description: A filled danger state, such as the danger button. Put text-on-danger on it.

color-background-danger-subtle.$description: A tinted danger fill, as in tags and toasts. Put text-danger on it.

color-background-highlight.$description: Behind the one marked phrase on a page. Put text-on-highlight on it.

color-backdrop.$description: The dimming layer behind a modal.

color-text-subtle.$description: Secondary text, such as descriptions and metadata.

color-text-subtlest.$description: The quietest text that still meets 4.5:1, such as helper text and hints.

color-text-selected.$description: The current item in a set.

color-text-disabled.$description: An unavailable control. Exempt from contrast, so say nearby why it is unavailable.

color-text-inverse.$description: Content on background-neutral-bold, such as tooltips.

color-icon-subtlest.$description: The quietest glyphs that still meet 3:1.

color-icon-selected.$description: The current item in a set.

color-icon-disabled.$description: An unavailable control. Exempt from contrast.

color-border-subtle.$description: A decorative hairline between rows and sections. Below 3:1, so never a control's only edge.

color-border-default.$description: Control edges that must be seen.

color-border-focused.$description: The focus ring on every interactive element.

color-border-selected.$description: Edge of the current item in a set.

color-border-disabled.$description: An unavailable control. Exempt from contrast.

color-material-thin.$description: Translucent fill for overlay chrome, with material-blur-thin. Solid under reduced transparency.

color-material-regular.$description: Translucent fill for overlay chrome, with material-blur-regular. Solid under reduced transparency.

color-material-thick.$description: Translucent fill for overlay chrome, with material-blur-thick. Solid under reduced transparency.

color-shadow-ring.$description: The hairline ring inside every elevation.

color-shadow-highlight.$description: The inner top highlight of every elevation, in the dark Theme only.

color-shadow-ambient.$description: The contact shadow inside every elevation.

color-shadow-key.$description: The key shadow of overlays and toasts.

opacity-disabled.$description: Fades an unavailable control that has no disabled color of its own.

opacity-subtle.$description: A faint trace of the current color, such as a keycap border on a colored host.

opacity-bold.$description: A slightly softened current color, such as keycap text on a colored host.

elevation-raised.$description: Controls: buttons, fields, switch and slider thumbs, and a hovered linked card.

elevation-modal.$description: Dialogs, sheets and the command palette.

type-heading-lg.$description: Serif heading. Grows from 29px to 33px with the viewport.

type-heading-md.$description: Serif heading. Grows from 24px to 26px with the viewport.

type-heading-sm.$description: Serif heading. Grows from 19px to 21px with the viewport.

type-display-md.$description: Serif display statement. Grows from 24px to 26px with the viewport.

type-body-lg.$description: Reading text. Grows from 19px to 21px with the viewport.

type-data-md.$description: Numbers in tables and stats, with tabular figures.

type-data-sm.$description: Numbers in tables and stats, with tabular figures.

size-indicator.$description: Small marks, such as status dots and meter tracks.

size-target-min.$description: The smallest pointer target WCAG 2.5.8 allows.

focus-ring-width.$description: The width of the focus ring.

focus-ring-offset.$description: The gap between an element and its focus ring.

z-index-tooltip.$description: The highest layer. Overlays in the top layer, such as popovers and dialogs, need no z-index.

layout-column-width.$description: The longest comfortable line of reading text.

layout-label-column-width.$description: The label column of a form laid out side by side.

breakpoint-md.$description: Where layouts switch to one column. Write the value in media queries; CSS cannot read a custom property there.

motion-easing-enter.$description: Things appearing or responding: decelerates into place.

motion-easing-move.$description: Something moving from one place on screen to another.

motion-easing-constant.$description: Linear progress, such as an indeterminate progress bar.

motion-duration-press.$description: The press feedback of buttons and controls.

motion-duration-hover-in.$description: Color change as the pointer arrives.

motion-duration-hover-out.$description: Color change as the pointer leaves; slower than hover-in.

motion-duration-exit.$description: Any overlay leaving; faster than its entrance.

motion-duration-swap.$description: Content swapping in place, such as a tab panel or a select value.

motion-duration-expand.$description: Content growing open, such as an accordion panel.

motion-duration-spring.$description: A selection settling into place, such as a switch thumb or a tab indicator.

motion-duration-toggle.$description: A checkbox, radio or switch changing state.

motion-duration-toast.$description: How long a toast stays before it dismisses itself. Not an animation.

motion-duration-toast-persistent.$description: How long a danger toast stays before it dismisses itself. Not an animation.

motion-delay-tooltip.$description: The wait before a tooltip shows on hover.

motion-duration-loop.$description: One cycle of a loading indicator.

motion-scale-pressed.$description: How far a control shrinks while pressed. Neutral under reduced motion.

motion-scale-enter.$description: The scale an overlay grows from. Neutral under reduced motion.

motion-scale-enter-modal.$description: The scale a dialog grows from. Neutral under reduced motion.
